items.title: Definition of Spices
items.explanation: A spice is any seed, fruit, root, bark, leaf or any other part of a plant used to give taste and colour to our food.

items.title: Examples of Spices
items.explanation: Examples of spices include turmeric, fenugreek, cumin seeds, asafoetida, cinnamon, clove, ginger, black pepper, fennel seeds, cardamom.

items.title: Benefits of Turmeric (Haldi)
items.explanation: Turmeric helps in improving energy level and digestion, reduces body pain, and is known as haldi.

items.title: Benefits of Fenugreek (Methi)
items.explanation: Fenugreek helps in keeping sugar level and body weight in control. It can also help manage cough and cold.

items.title: Benefits of Cumin Seeds (Jeera)
items.explanation: Cumin seeds soaked in water overnight can improve digestion and help cure sleeplessness.

items.title: Benefits of Asafoetida (Heeng)
items.explanation: Asafoetida can help control cough and cold. It is used to give relief from gas in the tummy.

items.title: Benefits of Cinnamon (Dalchini)
items.explanation: Cinnamon gives relief when we have toothache until we can consult a dentist.

items.title: Benefits of Clove (Laung)
items.explanation: Clove gives relief when we have toothache until we can consult a dentist.

items.title: Benefits of Ginger (Adrak)
items.explanation: Ginger helps us when we have cough and cold. It also gives relief from pain and is used in cooking for more than 4000 years.

items.title: Benefits of Black Pepper (Kali mirch)
items.explanation: Black pepper is helpful in digestion and can give us relief from body pain.

items.title: Benefits of Fennel Seeds (Saunf)
items.explanation: Fennel seeds help in the digestion of food when served at the end of a meal.

items.title: Benefits of Cardamom (Elaichi)
items.explanation: Cardamom helps with digestion and respiratory troubles, and cures bad breath.
